title: Current reconstruction and adaptive ship path following in Yingongzhou: companion simulation data
description: Eight manuscript tables, reconstructed-current exports, preserved computational sources, experiment notes, and four newly recovered full-route steady-field records. The steady runs reproduce all reported RMS and maximum errors. Original phase, information-error, derivative-perturbation, and cell-refinement time series were not retained; their values are explicitly marked as manuscript-level summaries. No observational current dataset is included.
repository_status: GitHub companion-data repository provisioned; retained data and archive limitations are documented in README.md. No DOI assigned.
